title: Best Day in Barcelona
text: Our private tour was one of the best we had. Syed was so polite and helped us plan our day. We had a great time at Montserrat and then to a spectacular winery.  Couldn’t have had a better experience.
author: Susan_R

title: One of the best tours I have ever taken!
text: This tour was absolutely one of the best I’ve ever taken, and I’ve taken a lot. The group coordinator was in touch with me every step of the way, very professional and very receptive. Our tour was led by Alex, and if you ever get the chance to see Misseraut With him, it will be so worth your while. He is from that area actually goes to that church and knows the people around the community. He made it very simple for us to actually access the church and knew a lot of history of the area.
